entry.title: Updated: dsh-sideband
entry.summary: Hand off focused context without waiting for or interrupting the active Agent: freeze a bounded Session snapshot, summarize it asynchronously with an isolated no-tool LLM, and deliver a provenance-bearing capsule to another Session or an authorized Room—quiet by default for Sessions, with explicit wakeup available. Exact install spec: github:ishuowang/dsh-sideband. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: description, description_i18n.
